column4:
Raids form the core of gear farming and it is an important mode where you need to ensure 100% successful and efficient runs.
Actual stats are not reflected here as it is unrealistic to be chasing stats when you are literally farming for the gears required. 
However, once speed and farming come into play, accessories play a key role.

column6: Can also use Sieg and Shane backline.
column19: A very very insane build is needed for this to happen smoothly, involving an Immortal X Guts for Bai Long so that he can survive the entire duration, while capitalizing on his large DMG output. Shane is less recommended as there are few debuffs to leverage on.

● Magic Type and inflicts MDMG
● Has MDMG Resistance

column19: Biscuit's enhancement on her Basic ATK can come in handy to reduce the boss' DMG dealt. In this case, you would want Biscuit to have over 60 Speed so that she is faster than the boss.
Try to get some Weakness Hit on Espada if possible too to achieve higher DMG.

column2:
● Support Type and inflicts MDMG
● Summons "Red Boils" with high DMG Resistance buff, hence the need for Buff Removal
● Ox King himself has 0 Defense so DEF Reduction does not influence DMG output

column6: Daisy may require a DMG Taken Reduction piece if she is not at T2 and unable to cast the barrier when both skills are used. You may also use Orly over Lina to increase Crit Rate & Crit DMG sufficiently if gears lack some %.
column19: Make sure Black Rose has high Crit Rate in order to kill the minions. Sometimes if she dies too easily, you will need 1 DMG Taken Reduction armor with 1 ATK piece. Some players also run Gatekeeper set for her but with Crit Rate main stats on weapons.
Without Biscuit, both farmers must have 100% Weakness (otherwise you would be gambling with a chance of them hitting the side heads and this will result in failure).

column2:
● DEF Type and inflicts PDMG
● Has PDMG Resistance
● Center Head starts with lowest HP among the three heads, making weakness hit chance an important mechanic in this raid

column6: For the best results, gear heroes with high Weakness Hit Chance stats/substats so that they will aim the middle head more consistently. Particularly Lucy, who can reduce the middle head's PDMG dealt.
column19: Without Biscuit, both farmers must have 100% Weakness Hit Chance. Even though Wukong has AOE DMG, his basic ATK also needs to land on the middle head.
